purpose: Verified contract for separating private investigation material from public answer content.
source_basis: Irish Data Protection Commission data-protection principles
Ireland Housing Data privacy and data-minimisation boundary
Ireland Housing Data access and role boundary
Ireland Housing Data citizen consent and control boundary

must_minimise: other personal data not necessary for public understanding

private_contract.must_remain_scoped: Only information necessary for the stated investigation purpose should be retained or processed.

restricted_contract.rule: Restricted source material is not automatically publishable merely because it was used internally.
restricted_contract.presentation: Where useful, summarise the material fact without exposing restricted content, subject to lawful publication scope.

publication_rule: Public answer rendering occurs only after answer quality review and privacy/publication boundary checks.
verification_boundary: This contract controls information presentation; it does not create a legal right to access or disclose any particular record.
